about_the_game:
Glimpse into a dark and erotic Metroidvania packed with fast-paced combat and immersive NSFW content.

Take control of Myrritha, a fallen succubus cursed and stripped of her powers. Use lust driven abilities and Hack n Slash combat to reclaim your strength and dominate a corrupted world.

Whats in this Demo?

• Combat System

Master dual-blade melee and dark magic with fluid hack-and-slash mechanics. Perform aerials, 3-hit combos, and unleash punishing finishers.

• Opening Gameplay & Exploration

Explore the first dungeon zone and corrupted ruins. Discover hidden paths, engage enemies, and unlock your succubus potential.

• Lewd Animations and Finisher System

Drain MP from enemies through fully animated erotic finishers using your Lustweaver whip. These scenes are not just fanservice—they’re core to gameplay and progression.

• Sacrificial Altar Preview

Gain early access to the altar system in your hub. Preview two group ritual setups using an interactive 360° ritual camera. Animations coming soon.

• First Boss Battle: Sil’Kethra

Fight the Obsidian Domina in a challenging cinematic encounter complete with story dialogue and a lewd animated boss finisher.

• Succubus Lair

Get a preview of your home base after the boss fight. The lair will serve as the foundation for upgrades, ability enhancement and ritual management in future updates.

Playtime and Content

This demo includes 1–2 hours of gameplay, with multiple animated scenes, a full boss fight, and a taste of upcoming features.

A World of Sin and Power Awaits!

Succubus: The Lustborn Curse combines satisfying action with richly animated adult content in a mature, story-driven world of darkness and desire. Whether you're drawn to the combat, the corruption, or the kink, this journey offers something wickedly unforgettable.
